title: GDP/CPI/IIP growth saga

blocks.content:
**[Jan] First Advance Estimates, FY26:** NSO pegs **7.4%** real GDP growth (vs 6.5% FY25); India became world's 4th-largest economy (~$4.18 trillion), overtaking Japan; on track to overtake Germany for 3rd by 2030.

**[Jan]→[Feb] Base-year revision, realised on schedule:** CPI new series (base **2024=100**) released **12 Feb 2026** — Jan 2026 CPI **2.75%** vs old-series Dec 2025 figure 1.33%. GDP new series (base 2022-23) released 27 Feb 2026. IIP new series (base 2022-23) due 28 May 2026.

**[Feb] WPI Jan 2026**: 1.81% (provisional); **WPI base year unchanged at 2011-12** — deliberate trap against CPI's new 2024 base.

**[Feb] Eight Core Industries Index**: +4% (provisional), Jan 2026 y-o-y; base 2011-12=100.

**[Feb] IIP Dec 2025**: 26-month high **7.8%**.

**[Mar] 🔄 IIP continuation**: IIP quick estimate falls to **4.8% YoY** in **January 2026** — down sharply from December's 7.8% high. Base year still 2011-12=100.

**[Mar] 🔄 CPI continuation**: Feb 2026 CPI (new 2024=100 base) eases further to **3.21%** (provisional); rural 3.37%, urban 3.02%; food inflation 3.47%.

**[Mar] 🔄 ICI continuation**: Combined Index of Eight Core Industries, Feb 2026, grew **2.3%** (provisional) — down from Jan's 4% reading; 8 core industries = 40.27% of IIP weight.

**[Mar] 🔄 Fiscal deficit revised upward** after the new GDP base-year update (published 27 Feb 2026): **4.9% (FY25)**, **5.7% (FY24)**, **6.7% (FY23)** — vs. earlier estimates 4.8%/5.63%/6.4% for the same years. Nominal GDP (new 2022-23 base): ₹318.07 lakh crore (FY25), ₹289.84 lakh crore (FY24).

**[Mar] WPI Feb 2026**: 2.13% (provisional), base 2011-12 — continues the WPI-still-on-old-base trap.

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — This is the single densest multi-fact trap saga across the quarter: **three different base years** (CPI=2024, WPI=2011-12, GDP/IIP=2022-23) across four series; **IIP trend reversal** (7.8%→4.8%); **CPI trend easing** (2.75%→3.21% is actually a rise, don't assume monotonic — check direction each month); **fiscal deficit old-vs-revised** trio (4.8→4.9 / 5.63→5.7 / 6.4→6.7). Flashcard this cluster as one unit, month by month.
